summary: Build results frameworks, SMART indicators, and reporting tools in this advanced 5-day course. Enroll to strengthen evidence-based programme delivery.
lede: Theory of Change and results-based management help programme teams connect intended outcomes to measurable evidence. This course is for programme, monitoring and evaluation professionals who need to turn strategy into results frameworks, map causal pathways, set indicators and baselines, and use monitoring data and learning loops to inform decisions. It also introduces contribution analysis and evaluation choices.
audienceIntro: This advanced course is intended for professionals who already work with programme logic, indicators, monitoring data, or evaluation reporting and now need stronger delivery discipline.
prerequisites: Advanced-level familiarity with programme planning, monitoring and evaluation, or results reporting is required. You should already have working knowledge of logical frameworks, indicators, and basic monitoring data, and you should be able to bring a real programme, project, policy initiative, or intervention to class for applied exercises. A laptop is required for workshop activities, and no coding is required for completion. Advanced concepts such as contribution analysis, adaptive management, and evaluation use are taught at an operational level, with emphasis on constructing and applying tools rather than designing research-grade methods from scratch.
